1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 46 cm de longitud, de aletas radiadas, cuerpo lateralmente comprimido, amarillo con rayas longitudinales estrechas de color azul, que se inician en la cabeza y recorren todo el cuerpo. Haemulidae, Haemulon sciurus.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish reaching up to 46 cm in length, characterized by radiated fins and a laterally compressed body, yellow with narrow longitudinal stripes of blue color that begin at the head and run along the entire body. Family Haemulidae, species Haemulon sciurus.
